quarterly_data.quarter: Anritsu press release: Anritsu PCIe Measurement Solution Selected for High-Speed (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Design win: Kioxia selected Anritsu's Signal Quality Analyzer-R MP1900A (a PCIe bit error rate tester) for quality evaluation of the high-speed interfaces used in its PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 6.0 SSDs. Kioxia uses the MP1900A in the development of PCIe 6.0 SSDs for compliance testing (FBER, Rx/Tx LEQ and link training evaluations) and for development and debugging (rare-error analysis with the Capture function, state-machine analysis with the Sequence Editor). The release ties this to faster PCIe interfaces in enterprise and data center SSDs as AI and cloud servers demand higher-performance storage.
